command:
set -eu
sed -i '/^PrivateTmp=/d; /^ProtectSystem=strict/a ReadOnlyPaths=/\nReadWritePaths=/var/lib/inventory' /etc/systemd/system/inventory-worker.service
systemctl stop inventory-worker.service
sed -i '\|^/bin/bash inventory-worker alive$|d' /var/lib/inventory/worker.log
systemctl daemon-reload
systemctl start inventory-worker.service
sleep 2
pid=$(systemctl show -p MainPID --value inventory-worker.service)
uid=$(ps -o uid= -p "$pid" | tr -d ' ')
gid=$(ps -o gid= -p "$pid" | tr -d ' ')
printf 'PID=%s UID=%s GID=%s\n' "$pid" "$uid" "$gid"
printf '%s\n' '--- MOUNT WRITE TESTS AS SERVICE UID ---'
for path in /etc /tmp /var/tmp /run /dev/shm; do
  probe="$path/inventory-worker-write-probe"
  if nsenter -t "$pid" -m -- setpriv --reuid "$uid" --regid "$gid" --clear-groups touch "$probe" 2>/tmp/inventory-probe.err; then
    printf 'UNEXPECTED_WRITABLE %s\n' "$path"
    rm -f "$probe"
  else
    printf 'BLOCKED %s: ' "$path"
    cat /tmp/inventory-probe.err
  fi
done
nsenter -t "$pid" -m -- setpriv --reuid "$uid" --regid "$gid" --clear-groups touch /var/lib/inventory/.write-probe
printf 'ALLOWED /var/lib/inventory\n'

printf '%s\n' '--- PRIVILEGE STATE ---'

printf '%s\n' '--- SERVICE STATE ---'
